tests.name: Player stats accuracy calculated correctly after completed game
tests.why: Catches servers that return accuracy as a string instead of a float, compute it incorrectly, or fail to update stats after a game completes.

tests.name: Fire into a finished game returns 400
tests.why: Catches servers that do not enforce game state and allow moves after the game is already finished.

tests.name: Join a full game returns 400
tests.why: Catches servers that allow more players than max_players without enforcing the capacity limit.

tests.name: Creating a player with the same username twice returns the same player_id
tests.why: Catches servers that create duplicate players instead of reusing persistent identity, breaking the cross-game stats requirement.

tests.name: Player stats survive a test restart
tests.why: Catches servers that wipe player lifetime statistics when resetting a game instead of only clearing ships and moves.
